v.text: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Retirement of Mr. Noel N Tata as the Chairman
Trent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Rajiv Dube as Non- Executive Director of the company w.e.f. October 30, 2026.
Trent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
Trent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mrs Kalpana Merchant as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. October 30, 2026.

Trent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 29, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for thesecond quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026".
Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
Trent Limited has submitted to the Exchange about Outcome of Board Meeting held today i.e. 29th October 2026
